_note: Grid systems a book is set on (one per book). margins in mm unless 'frac' (fraction of page width for inner/outer, of page height for top/bottom). rows = horizontal flowlines inside the margins. Sources: knowledge/editorial/layout-craft.md (UW grid handout; Van de Graaf/Rosarivo ninths; illustrarch practice).

systems.note: Muller-Brockmann style: many narrow columns, equal margins; most flexible (illustrarch: 12 columns on A3).
Magazine feature grid: fewer, wider columns; heavier foot margin; wider outer margin for marginal notes.
Van de Graaf / Rosarivo ninths: type area 2/3 x 2/3 of the page, inner:top:outer:bottom = 1:1:2:2 (book pages, spreads).
Coarse modular grid: four columns, four rows; for image-led pages with few words (illustrarch: 6 or fewer for image-heavy).
